title: Wollen, möchten und Sollen wir…?
summary: wollen vs. the politer möchten for plans, plus Sollen wir…? for offers and suggestions

blocks.title: wollen vs. möchten
blocks.body: **wollen** (to want) is direct and can sound blunt: *Ich will ins Kino gehen* (I want to go to the cinema — matter-of-fact, even a bit bossy). **möchten** is the polite cousin, softer, like "would like": *Ich möchte ins Kino gehen*. Both push the second verb to the infinitive at the very end.
blocks.callout: Rule of thumb: reach for *möchten* with people you don't know well; *wollen* is fine with close friends — or when you're sure.

pairs.right: Ich möchte jetzt gehen, wenn das okay ist. — softer
pairs.note: Same wish, different tone. möchte smooths almost any request.

blocks.prompt: You're asking your colleague's boss, who you barely know, if you can leave early. Which is more polite?
blocks.explain: *möchte* is the polite form — safer with someone you don't know well. (The third option also has wrong word order: *jetzt* must come before *gehen*.)

blocks.title: Sollen wir…? — making an offer
blocks.body: To suggest doing something together, ask **Sollen wir + Infinitiv?** — literally "should we…?", but it lands as a friendly proposal: *Sollen wir ins Kino gehen?* (Shall we go to the cinema?) Answer with *Ja, gern!* or soften a no with *Ich weiß nicht, vielleicht lieber…*

blocks.prompt: Type the question: 'Shall we go to the Kneipe?'
answers: Sollen wir in die Kneipe gehen?
Sollen wir in die Kneipe gehen
blocks.explain: *Sollen wir in die Kneipe gehen?* — the infinitive *gehen* closes the sentence, same pattern as werden and other modal verbs.

blocks.title: Mach einen Vorschlag
blocks.prompt: Build a suggestion with Sollen wir…?

blocks.scene: Jonas texts you about the weekend.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.nl: Ey, hast du Lust? Sollen wir am Samstag in die Kneipe gehen?
lines.en: Hey, feel like it? Shall we go to the pub on Saturday?
lines.spotlight: Sollen wir + infinitive: the go-to way to propose a plan.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Gute Idee! Ich möchte auch Lena einladen.
lines.en: Good idea! I'd like to invite Lena too.

lines.speaker: Jonas
lines.nl: Passt! Ich will auch Aylin fragen, aber sie hat oft viel zu tun.
lines.en: Works for me! I want to ask Aylin too, but she's often got a lot going on.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Okay, dann schreibe ich ihr auch kurz.
lines.en: Okay, I'll message her too then.

options: Going to the pub on Saturday

questions.q: Who does Jonas want to ask too?

blocks.prompt: Schreib einen Vorschlag: what do you want to do this weekend, and what would you like to do with a friend? Use wollen, möchten, and Sollen wir…?
